text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Indignant Iraqis remember bombing of Amiriya shelter by allied warplanes during the 1991 Gulf War over Kuwait.
- Information ministry spokesman says U.S. war games in Kuwait are meant to blackmail Gulf states.
- Zionist warplanes continue their bombing of Lebanon.
- U.S. concerned over tension between Greece and Turkey.
- Egyptian newspaper criticises delays in arrival of foodstuffs to Iraq.
- President Saddam Hussein receives more congratulations on Eid al-Fitr.
